title: MATLAB Onramp
summary: Learn the MATLAB workspace, arrays, scripts, calculations, plots, and basic troubleshooting before touching the team model.
source_note: Onramp courses are free with a MathWorks Account. Confirm the team-approved MATLAB release and campus-license path before installing desktop software.
prerequisites: Confirmed team MATLAB release and license method
steps: Ask the PCM lead which MATLAB release the team is using; do not upgrade a shared model by opening and saving it in a newer release.
Sign in to your MathWorks Account and open the official MATLAB Onramp course.
Complete the introductory lessons on commands, variables, arrays, indexing, plots, and scripts.
Create a personal practice script named onboarding_<initials>.m; load or define a small data vector, calculate a mean, and produce a labeled plot.
Add a title, axis labels, units, and one comment explaining the calculation.
Save a completion screenshot and your practice script in the approved onboarding location, then ask the PCM mentor for a five-minute review.
proof: Onramp completion screenshot plus one readable MATLAB script and labeled plot.

title: Simulink + TI C2000 F280039C
summary: Install and validate the model-based embedded controls toolchain used with the TI F280039C LaunchPad.
source: Team TI C2000 MATLAB/Simulink setup guide, supported by MathWorks and TI documentation
source_note: The attached screenshots show a specific Windows setup and older tool versions. Use the versions selected by the PCM lead or recommended by the current c2000setup wizard; do not mix versions on a shared project without approval.
prerequisites: TI F280039C LaunchPad access for the final hardware check
steps: Install the approved MATLAB release and the project-required products, including Simulink and C2000 Microcontroller Blockset; confirm with the PCM lead before adding optional products.
In the MATLAB Command Window, enter c2000setup and select the F28003x processor family.
Allow the hardware setup workflow to install or locate the required code-generation support, Code Composer Studio, and C2000Ware. Use the wizard-recommended or team-pinned versions.
Keep TI tools in their standard C:\ti folders unless the team has documented a different location.
Use each Validate button in the hardware setup workflow and resolve every failed path before continuing.
Open Simulink, open the Library Browser, and confirm that C2000 Microcontroller Blockset contains F28003x blocks.
In Model Settings > Hardware Implementation, select TI F280039C LaunchPad and confirm Texas Instruments / C2000 device settings.
Run a software-only practice model first. Perform code generation, flashing, or energized hardware work only with the PCM mentor and the team's safety procedure.
proof: Screenshots of successful tool validation, the F28003x block library, and the selected F280039C hardware board; add tool versions to the run log.

title: Siemens NX
summary: Install NX through the approved university package, connect to the campus license, and release one practice part.
source: Team Siemens NX download and installation guide
source_note: The attached guide names SiemensNX-2206.9200_wntx64 but does not provide a public installer link. Obtain the approved installer and current license-server value from the VHI/NX lead or controlled team storage.
prerequisites: Windows computer with installation permission and sufficient disk space
Approved NX installer and controlled license-server value
steps: Obtain the team-approved NX installer from the VHI/NX lead; confirm the release before downloading.
Extract the full installer folder, open it, and run Launch.exe.
Choose Install NX, proceed through the setup wizard, and keep the approved feature set and installation location.
Install and connect GlobalProtect to the MyStudent VPN using your own university credentials.
At the NX Licensing screen, enter the license-server value from the controlled setup guide. Do not publish that value in GitHub or screenshots.
Select the team language setting, review the summary, and install NX.
Launch NX while connected to VPN. If licensing fails, capture the exact error and send it to the NX lead; do not repeatedly change server settings.
Create a simple practice part, save it with the team's naming convention, and complete the practice release/check-in steps provided by the CAD custodian.
proof: NX launch screenshot plus one named practice part and release/check-in screenshot reviewed by the CAD custodian.
